items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: So he put me to work and I could read.

ctx.x: Yeah, a real early militant because I just wasn't going to bow down for anything. So then my brother said -- he told my mother I had to do something, and he wasn't going to have me hanging around doing nothing and he was going to put me to work playing piano, and I cried. With his band. Oh, I cried. I couldn't play that good, he said well you're going to play, you're going to practice and you're going to play. You don't want to do anything, you've got to work, you've got to help mama. So he put me to work and I…
